technique.hxh.cond.charge_strike: Hold to charge (up to 2 s), release to strike (%s blocks)
technique.hxh.silva_great_orb.desc: Silva forms a large aura orb in one second and launches it: it carries the target and explodes without digging.
technique.hxh.mob_nen_arrows.desc: Three aura arrows in a fan that fly straight without dropping.
technique.hxh.mob_aura_mines.desc: Four mines around the target burst a moment later; the creeper no longer explodes itself.
technique.hxh.mob_nen_horde.desc: Two aura zombies rise from the ground and attack; they fade after 15 s.
technique.hxh.mob_aura_web.desc: An aura thread pins the target: heavily slowed, it cannot jump.
technique.hxh.mob_blink_strike.desc: Appears behind the target and strikes.
technique.hxh.mob_boar_charge.desc: Rushes the target and knocks it over.
technique.hxh.mob_egg_barrage.desc: A volley of aura eggs bursting around the target.
technique.hxh.mob_fang_lunge.desc: A leaping bite that makes the target bleed.
technique.hxh.mob_bounce_slam.desc: Jumps very high and lands in a shockwave.
technique.hxh.mob_nen_brew.desc: Weakens and slows everything around it.
technique.hxh.mob_quake_stomp.desc: Stomps the ground: everything around is thrown back.
technique.hxh.mob_fire_rain.desc: Aura fireballs fall around the target.
technique.hxh.cond.hold_bolt: Hold: discharges ahead (%s blocks), rising cost
message.hxh.en_run: You are running: your En scatters
message.hxh.ko_cancelled: Ko released (the aura spent is lost)
message.hxh.ko_faded: Out of aura: the Ko fades
gamerule.randomNenType.description: Each new Hunter gets a random Nen type, hidden until the water divination.
message.hxh.heal_locked: You don't know how to heal with Nen yet.
message.hxh.heal_zetsu: You can't heal while in Zetsu.
message.hxh.open_pores_cooldown: You must wait before opening more pores.
message.hxh.awakened_by_master: A foreign aura strikes your body: your pores are forced open!
message.hxh.awakened_by_meditation: After a long meditation, your aura finally awakens!
message.hxh.awakened_by_accident: The Nen-charged blow opened your pores by accident!
message.hxh.awakened_hint: Your aura is leaking… Use Ten to hold it in.
screen.hxh.hatsu.title: Choose your Hatsu
screen.hxh.hatsu.your_type: Your Nen type: %s — permanent choice (Esc to close)
screen.hxh.hatsu.confirm_text: This choice is permanent: you won't be able to change character.
message.hxh.hatsu_need_divination: First discover your type with the water divination.
message.hxh.hatsu_wrong_type: This character is not of your Nen type.
message.hxh.hatsu_none: You don't have a Hatsu yet.
kit.hxh.netero.desc: Chairman of the Association, absolute master of Enhancement. His strength comes from Prayer.
passive.hxh.netero_prayer.desc: A Prayer gauge of Netero's own. "Meditate" becomes "Pray": standing still, hands joined, the gauge fills (full in 20 s). Each Kannon technique spends part of it.
technique.hxh.netero_kannon.desc: Kannon's huge statue rises behind Netero and strikes everything in front with a giant palm (12 blocks). Costs 30 Prayer.
technique.hxh.netero_zero_hand.desc: Full Prayer: everything is spent. A beam of pure aura bursts from the statue (24 blocks, 40 damage).
passive.hxh.pariston_charisma.desc: A monster targeting you has a one-in-three chance to forget you (every 3 s). A debtor (Love Debt) takes half the damage it deals you.
technique.hxh.pariston_love_debt.desc: Marks a target (10 blocks) for 10 s: half the damage it deals you comes back to it. A pink heart marks it.
kit.hxh.ging.desc: Le père de Gon, Hunter de légende et archéologue.
passive.hxh.ging_archaeologist.desc: Every 10 s, points out the nearest chest (24 blocks).
technique.hxh.ging_copy.desc: Reproduces, at 70% power, the last technique cast near you (16 blocks).
technique.hxh.ging_emission_punch.desc: An aura fist bursts from a portal next to the target (10 blocks).
technique.hxh.cheadle_rules.desc: 8-block zone for 8 s: enemies are slowed and can no longer teleport.
passive.hxh.botobai_veteran.desc: Resists knockback; weakness and slowness last half as long.
technique.hxh.botobai_pressure.desc: A 6-block wave crushes enemies: slowness and weakness.
kit.hxh.biscuit.desc: Maîtresse du Shingen-ryu, experte en pierres précieuses.
passive.hxh.biscuit_gem_expert.desc: IDÉE : repère les minerais précieux proches et augmente leur butin.
technique.hxh.biscuit_esthetician.desc: Cookie heals Biscuit and allies within 3 blocks, regeneration and a little saturation.
technique.hxh.biscuit_true_form.desc: IDÉE : révèle son vrai corps musclé : force et résistance énormes pendant un temps, lenteur ensuite.
kit.hxh.menchi.desc: Hunter gastronome, examinatrice de l'Examen Hunter.
passive.hxh.menchi_gastronome.desc: Food fills you twice as much.
technique.hxh.menchi_gourmet_meal.desc: A dish shared with allies within 6 blocks: healing, regeneration, Strength.
technique.hxh.bushidora_aura_blade.desc: The blade stretches and slashes everything in front in an arc (6 blocks).
kit.hxh.tsezguerra.desc: Hunter chasseur de primes, chef d'équipe à Greed Island.
passive.hxh.tsezguerra_leader.desc: Allies within 8 blocks gain Strength I.
kit.hxh.silva.desc: Chef de la famille d'assassins Zoldyck.
passive.hxh.silva_zoldyck.desc: IDÉE : immunité au poison et à l'électricité (comme Killua).
technique.hxh.silva_explosive_orbs.desc: Three purple aura spheres, one after another, at the target (16 blocks).
passive.hxh.zeno_zoldyck.desc: IDÉE : immunité au poison et à l'électricité, et En très étendu (voit les ennemis à travers les murs).
technique.hxh.zeno_dragon_head.desc: A golden aura dragon bursts from his hand and strikes the target (14 blocks).
technique.hxh.zeno_dragon_dive.desc: The dragon splits into dozens of small dragons raining around the aimed point.
kit.hxh.hisoka.desc: Unpredictable magician who lives for battle.
passive.hxh.hisoka_thrill.desc: The tougher the opponent (max health), the harder you hit: +1% per HP above 20, up to +30%.
technique.hxh.hisoka_bungee_gum.desc: Sticks elastic aura onto the target in front of you. While the link holds (10 s), it is pulled back whenever it gets away. Cast again: the band snaps and flings it against you.
technique.hxh.hisoka_texture_surprise.de: You cover your body with a fake texture: you vanish for 8 s in a burst of cards, and monsters lose track of you.
kit.hxh.zushi.desc: Élève de Wing à la Tour Céleste.
passive.hxh.chrollo_leader.desc: IDÉE : les membres de la Brigade proches deviennent plus forts.
technique.hxh.chrollo_skill_hunter.desc: Empty book: steals the last technique cast by the target (10 blocks). Full page: casts it once, then the page fades.
passive.hxh.feitan_pain.desc: Each HP lost fills the Pain gauge; it drains out of combat. Up to +50% damage when full.
technique.hxh.feitan_rising_sun.desc: Full Pain: a sun of fire rises above Feitan and burns everything within 8 blocks.
passive.hxh.nobunaga_en.desc: A small permanent En: enemies within 4 blocks glow.
technique.hxh.nobunaga_iai.desc: An instant cut on everything in your En (4 blocks).
passive.hxh.phinks_brawler.desc: The next punch releases the stored arm turns: +2.5 damage per turn.
technique.hxh.phinks_ripper_cyclotron.de: One more arm turn. Maximum: 1 turn per 10 Nen levels (up to 10).
passive.hxh.neon_fortune.desc: A little luck at all times (Luck I).
technique.hxh.neon_lovely_ghostwriter.de: A poem foretells dangers within 32 blocks (count, direction) and makes them glow for 10 s.
kit.hxh.razor.desc: Maître du jeu à Greed Island.
technique.hxh.razor_aura_ball.desc: An aura ball struck very hard at the target (18 blocks), big knockback.
technique.hxh.razor_fourteen_devils.desc: Fourteen aura devils bombard the area around the aimed point.
kit.hxh.kite.desc: Disciple de Ging, Hunter des espèces.
technique.hxh.kite_crazy_slots.desc: The roulette picks a random weapon: scythe, rifle, staff or clown.
passive.hxh.knov_strategist.desc: Warned when a monster targets him. With Gyo, he sees his marked doors.
technique.hxh.knov_hide_and_seek.desc: A portal to the refuge room (shelter, regeneration). In the refuge: choose which marked door to come out of.
kit.hxh.knuckle.desc: Hunter au grand cœur, élève de Morel.
passive.hxh.knuckle_tough.desc: IDÉE : plus résistant à faible vie.
technique.hxh.knuckle_hakoware.desc: IDÉE : « prête » de l'aura à la cible à chaque coup ; avec les intérêts, si la dette dépasse son aura, elle est forcée en Zetsu.
kit.hxh.morel.desc: Hunter de l'équipe d'extermination, fumeur de pipe.
passive.hxh.morel_smoke.desc: When hit, a one-in-five chance to vanish for 2 s in a cloud.
technique.hxh.morel_deep_purple.desc: Smoke soldiers assail the front: blows and blindness.
passive.hxh.meruem_king.desc: Each enemy defeated strengthens him (+0.5% damage, up to 25%).
technique.hxh.meruem_rage_blast.desc: A devastating dark aura wave around him (7 blocks).
technique.hxh.meruem_photon.desc: A concentrated white aura beam (20 blocks).
passive.hxh.pouf_wings.desc: He flies freely with his butterfly wings (not in Zetsu). No fall damage.
technique.hxh.pouf_spiritual_message.des: A golden powder within 8 blocks: enemies glow, slowed and disoriented.
technique.hxh.pouf_beelzebub.desc: He splits into a swarm: invisible and fast for 6 s, the mini-Poufs harass nearby enemies.
kit.hxh.youpi.desc: Garde royal du roi, monstre de puissance.
technique.hxh.youpi_metamorphosis.desc: Arms turn into weapons: Strength II and Resistance for 15 s.
technique.hxh.youpi_rage_blast.desc: An explosion of anger around him (6 blocks).
kit.hxh.uvogin.desc: Membre de la Brigade, force brute pure.
technique.hxh.uvogin_big_bang_impact.des: Uvogin charges his fist (hold up to 2 s) then smashes the ground ahead: the fuller the charge, the bigger the crater (1 to 6 blocks), the harder the hit and the farther the knockback.
technique.hxh.franklin_double_machine_gu: His ten fingers fire a burst of aura at the target (18 blocks).
kit.hxh.shalnark.desc: Membre de la Brigade, manipulateur par antenne.
passive.hxh.shalnark_tech.desc: A defeated mob sometimes drops one more item (one in four).
technique.hxh.shalnark_black_voice.desc: An antenna planted in a mob (8 blocks): for 30 s it attacks your enemies. Fails if the target has more than 10 Nen levels over you.
technique.hxh.shalnark_autopilot.desc: He controls himself: 15 s overpowered, then 10 s exhausted.
kit.hxh.machi.desc: Membre de la Brigade, maîtresse des fils.
passive.hxh.machi_suture.desc: Heals 1 HP every 4 s, and allies within 3 blocks too.
technique.hxh.machi_nen_threads.desc: Fine threads bind the target (10 blocks): greatly slowed, can't jump.
passive.hxh.shizuku_cleaner.desc: Pulls items on the ground within 5 blocks.
technique.hxh.shizuku_blinky.desc: The vacuum sucks in front of you: projectiles destroyed, items collected, enemies pulled.
kit.hxh.pakunoda.desc: Membre de la Brigade, lit les souvenirs.
passive.hxh.pakunoda_mind_reader.desc: A melee hit reveals the target's health, Nen and aura.
technique.hxh.pakunoda_memory_bomb.desc: An aura bullet (16 blocks): the target is disoriented, slowed, briefly blinded.
kit.hxh.kalluto.desc: Le plus jeune Zoldyck, danse des papiers.
technique.hxh.kalluto_paper_dance.desc: A whirlwind of cutting paper sweeps the front for 2 s.
technique.hxh.genthru_little_flower.desc: He grabs the target and explodes in its face (his hand takes a little).
technique.hxh.genthru_countdown.desc: Plants a bomb on the target: 3, 2, 1… it explodes.
kit.hxh.senritsu.desc: Musicienne, entend les battements de cœur.
passive.hxh.senritsu_heart_sound.desc: She hears hidden enemies (Zetsu, invisible) within 20 blocks: they glow.
technique.hxh.senritsu_melody.desc: Her flute heals allies within 8 blocks, slows and weakens enemies.
kit.hxh.palm.desc: Élève de Knov, voyante, devenue fourmi-chimère.
passive.hxh.palm_wink_blue.desc: The last enemy you hit stays visible (glows for 30 s).
technique.hxh.palm_black_widow.desc: Black armor, blade-like hair: Strength II, Resistance, speed for 20 s.
kit.hxh.wing.desc: Maître de Gon et Killua, Shingen-ryu.
passive.hxh.wing_teacher.desc: Allies within 8 blocks slowly gain a little Nen.
technique.hxh.wing_shingen_ryu.desc: 10 s on guard: damage taken halved, each attacker takes 4 damage.
kit.hxh.gon.desc: A boy from Whale Island, pure Enhancer. His Jajanken plays rock-paper-scissors.
kit.hxh.killua.desc: Zoldyck heir: he turns his aura into electricity.
kit.hxh.kurapika.desc: Last survivor of the Kurta clan: conjured chains.
kit.hxh.neferpitou.desc: Royal guard of the Chimera Ant King, a feline specialist.
kit.hxh.illumi.desc: Eldest Zoldyck: needles that manipulate bodies.
kit.hxh.leorio.desc: Future doctor: he sends his punches through space.
passive.hxh.dowsing_chain.desc: Monsters within 12 blocks glow through walls.
technique.hxh.gon_rock.desc: Gon gathers aura in his fist, standing still: a half-player-sized orb glows and changes colour at each stage while the key is held. Releasing throws it straight ahead: it digs its way, carries the target along and explodes. The longer the charge, the more destructive. Ryu leaning on attack makes it bigger.
technique.hxh.gon_scissors.desc: Aura takes the shape of a blade that flies straight until it hits a block or an enemy.
technique.hxh.gon_paper.desc: Gon opens his palm and releases his aura at once: an emission cone that hits everything in front of him and throws it far away (Emission category: 80% for Gon).
technique.hxh.killua_thunderbolt.desc: An electric shock that nearly paralyses the target.
technique.hxh.killua_godspeed.desc: Electric reflexes: Speed III and Haste for 10 s.
technique.hxh.kurapika_chain_jail.desc: The chain binds the target (Slowness VII) and weakens it for 5 s.
technique.hxh.pitou_terpsichora.desc: Body puppeteering: Strength II, Speed II and Jump II for 10 s.
technique.hxh.pitou_doctor_blythe.desc: The surgeon doll appears above the wounded one in front of you (or yourself) and stitches them up: 16 HP over 4 s. You stay still during the operation.
technique.hxh.illumi_needle.desc: A needle that disrupts the body: Slowness III and Nausea for 5 s.
technique.hxh.illumi_transform.desc: Needles reshape his body: Resistance and Strength for 15 s.
technique.hxh.leorio_remote_punch.desc: The fist hits the ground and comes out under the target, up to 12 blocks.
technique.hxh.leorio_shockwave.desc: Hits the ground: a wave that hurts and pushes back everything around.
technique.hxh.cond.target: a target in front of you, up to %s blocks
screen.hxh.techniques.idea_notice: Character at the idea stage: the techniques below are proposals.
screen.hxh.techniques.miss_rule: A missed technique still costs its aura and starts its cooldown.
message.hxh.hatsu_not_available: This character is not playable yet.
screen.hxh.ryu.title: Ryu: aura distribution
screen.hxh.ryu.help: More aura in attack = more damage, less protection
dialog.hxh.navigator.idle: The exam site? It must be earned. Talk to me if you want to sign up.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.register: Welcome to the Hunter Exam. Keep your applicant badge safe, you will need it later.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.satotz: I am Satotz, examiner of the first phase. Follow me… and don't fall behind.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.buhara: Second phase! Bring me some pork, I'm starving!
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.netero: Congratulations. You are now a Hunter: here is your license.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.buhara_done: Bring the hunt back to Buhara
message.hxh.quest_left_behind: You're falling behind! Catch up with Satotz (%s s)
command.hxh.exam_setup: A Navigator is waiting next to you: talk to them to start the Exam.
dialog.hxh.receptionist.idle: Good luck! The referee is waiting by the ring, and the elevator takes you wherever you like.
quest.hxh.heavens_arena.welcome: Talk to the receptionist at the counter
quest.hxh.heavens_arena.first_win: Win a fight (your floors' hall, then the referee)
quest.hxh.heavens_arena.first_prize: Collect your prize at the counter
quest.hxh.heavens_arena.floor_50_prize: Get floor 50 validated at the counter
quest.hxh.heavens_arena.nen_warning: Register for floor 200 with the receptionist
dialog.hxh.heavens_arena.welcome: Welcome to Heavens Arena! You start on floors 1 to 50. Win and you go up; lose and you go down. Take the elevator to your floors' hall: the referee is waiting by the ring.
dialog.hxh.heavens_arena.first_prize: Your first win! Here's a welcome prize. Below floor 200, every win pays out Jenny.
dialog.hxh.heavens_arena.floor_50_prize: Floor 50 already! Fighters get serious from here on. Here's your prize.
dialog.hxh.heavens_arena.private_room: Floor 100 already! Here's a nice prize. Don't forget your room: the elevator takes you there anytime.
dialog.hxh.heavens_arena.nen_warning: Here you are on floor 200. No more prize money: here you fight for honour, and every fighter masters Nen.
message.hxh.arena_welcome: Welcome to Heavens Arena, the battleground of fighters from all over the world!
message.hxh.arena_missing: Heavens Arena cannot be found (missing dimension).
message.hxh.arena_registered: Registration complete: you will fight on floors %s.
message.hxh.arena_not_inside: The elevator only works inside Heavens Arena.
message.hxh.arena_not_registered: Register at the counter with the receptionist first.
message.hxh.arena_need_nen: Above floor 200, every fighter masters Nen. Come back once you have awakened it.
message.hxh.arena_no_teleport: You can't teleport inside Heavens Arena.
message.hxh.arena_fight_nen: Floor %s: your opponent masters Nen. Get ready.
message.hxh.arena_win_ring_out: Victory: your opponent left the ring!
message.hxh.arena_reached_200: You reached floor 200! Register with the receptionist: without Nen, you can't go further.
command.hxh.arena_info: Heavens Arena: floor %s · %s win(s), %s loss(es) · %s Jenny
dialog.hxh.referee.idle: Ready? Talk to me when you want to step into the ring.
dialog.hxh.referee.wrong_floor: Your floor is %s: your fight takes place in the hall of floors %s.
message.hxh.arena_floor_locked: You don't have access to these floors yet.
screen.hxh.elevator.title: Heavens Arena Elevator
subtitle.hxh.arena_floor_master: You reign over the top of Heavens Arena
screen.hxh.elevator.hint: Choose a destination: your floor bracket's hall or one you've already passed
message.hxh.arena_registered_bracket: Registered for floors %s. The referee is waiting by the ring.
message.hxh.arena_registered_200: Registration for floor 200 complete. Every fighter here masters Nen.
message.hxh.arena_register_need_nen: Without Nen, the receptionist can't register you for floor 200.
message.hxh.arena_register_bracket: You must first register with the receptionist of floors %s.
message.hxh.arena_register_200: You must first register for floor 200 with the receptionist.
message.hxh.arena_new_bracket: New floor bracket: %s! Go register with this hall's receptionist.
message.hxh.arena_demoted: You drop back to floors %s. You'll have to clear them again.
message.hxh.arena_floor_master: You are now a Floor Master of Heavens Arena!
message.hxh.arena_queued: The ring is busy (%s is fighting). You are #%s in the queue: stay in the hall.
message.hxh.arena_your_turn: The ring is free: it's your turn!
message.hxh.arena_ring_reserved: The ring is reserved for the fighters.
dialog.hxh.referee.master: Floor Master, no one in this Arena is a match for you anymore. The ring is yours.
dialog.hxh.receptionist.other_floor: This hall isn't your floor's. Your fight takes place in your own bracket.
dialog.hxh.receptionist.need_nen: I can't register you for floor 200 until you master Nen.
dialog.hxh.receptionist.master: Floor Master! It's an honour. The whole Arena is talking about your victory.
dialog.hxh.heavens_arena.master_title: Congratulations, Floor Master! You've conquered Heavens Arena. There's nothing more I can teach you here.
quest.hxh.heavens_arena.master_title: Announce your title to the receptionist
command.hxh.arena_register: Registration forced up to your current bracket (and floor 200 if needed).
command.hxh.arena_rebuild: Halls will be rebuilt on the next visit.
screen.hxh.profile.title: Hunter Notebook
profile.hxh.arena.title: Heavens Arena
profile.hxh.arena.register: To do: register with your bracket's receptionist.
tooltip.hxh.dumbbell: Hold right-click: +%s Strength XP per second
tooltip.hxh.treadmill: Run on it facing the arrows: +%s XP per second
tooltip.hxh.treadmill.mode: Right-click: Speed mode (sprint) or Endurance mode (walk)
tooltip.hxh.training.source_2: Tier II · upgraded from tier I
tooltip.hxh.training.source_3: Tier III · sold by the Heavens Arena merchant
tooltip.hxh.training.source_4: Tier IV · rare, at auctions (coming soon)
command.hxh.quest_start_failed: Cannot start quest %s (unknown, already running or completed).
tooltip.hxh.marker.waypoint: Right-click: +1 · sneak: −1 · the highest number is the finish
dialog.hxh.menchi.idle: Want to taste my exam? Come back when you know how to cook!
dialog.hxh.cook.idle: Welcome! What can I get you?
message.hxh.exam_failed_detail: You failed. Find a guide again: they will take you to new trials, in places you have never been.
quest.hxh.arena_register_pending: Register with the receptionist of floors %s
message.hxh.arena_back_in_ring: Out of the ring! Back to the centre — ring-outs no longer count here.
message.hxh.arena_items_stored: Bare-handed fight: your items are kept until the fight ends.
message.hxh.fear.1: %s's aura chills you to the bone!
message.hxh.fear.2: Terror: before %s, your body refuses to move!
command.hxh.quest_not_custom: The tracked quest's current step is not a "custom" step.
command.hxh.tower_at: Heavens Arena stands at %s %s %s (click to teleport).
command.hxh.tower_none: Heavens Arena hasn't been placed in this world yet.
technique.hxh.cond.charged: Hold to charge (%s aura/s, %s s max), release to throw
message.hxh.charge_too_short: Charge too short: the fist relaxes.
message.hxh.arena_no_hatsu: No techniques here: only in the ring, during a fight.
profile.hxh.learned_none: none (see Wing, in the Heavens Arena hall)
message.hxh.not_learned.ten: You haven't learned Ten yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.in: You haven't learned In yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.zetsu: You haven't learned Zetsu yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.ren: You haven't learned Ren yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.ken: You haven't learned Ken yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.gyo: You haven't learned Gyo yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.en: You haven't learned En yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.ko: You haven't learned Ko yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.ryu: You haven't learned Ryu yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.shu: You haven't learned Shu yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
message.hxh.not_learned.hatsu: You haven't learned Hatsu yet: see Wing, in the Heavens Arena entry hall.
technique.hxh.basic_attack.desc: A punch, right then left. No Nen. Endurance lowers the cooldown.
technique.hxh.basic_kick.desc: Knocks the target back according to your Strength. No Nen. Endurance lowers the cooldown.
technique.hxh.basic_charged.desc: Hold the key: the bar rises and falls; release in the green for a perfect strike. Endurance lowers the cooldown.
technique.hxh.cond.strike: Hold, then release in the green
technique.hxh.gon_rock_epic.desc: Gon puts everything into his fist: the orb swells to twice his size, then condenses into a tiny, blinding star. Anyone looking at it is dazzled. Costs twice the aura, hits much harder and digs a huge crater.
technique.hxh.cond.cone: everything in front of you, up to %s blocks, in a %s° cone
command.hxh.aura.wild: Wild aura: flames even at rest.
command.hxh.aura.calm: Calm aura: vapour at rest, flames with Ren and Ken.
technique.hxh.hisoka_cards.desc: A playing card reinforced with Nen, thrown like a blade. It cuts through whatever it hits.
technique.hxh.cond.gum: a target in front of you, up to %s blocks
screen.hxh.computer.title: Hunter website
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.cook: One steak combo, grilled over a low flame… Take a seat in the back room. (The room starts going down.)
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.cook: Order the daily special from the Zaban cook
command.hxh.exam_where: The Navigator is waiting for candidates at %s %s %s.
command.hxh.exam_where_none: The Navigator hasn't been placed yet.
command.hxh.exam_rebuild: Exam sites will be rebuilt on the next visit.
dialog.hxh.captain.idle: Hold on to the rail, the sea is rising.
dialog.hxh.quiz_granny.idle: Heh heh… think it over, think it over.
dialog.hxh.fake_satotz.idle: I'm the real examiner! Follow me, this way, into the swamp…
dialog.hxh.lippo.idle: Six points to pass: your badge and your target's are worth three, the others one.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.captain.question: Before we go any further: why do you want to become a Hunter?
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.captain: Hm. You've got guts. A storm is coming: stay on your feet until we make port and I'll tell you how to reach Zaban.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.granny.question: Bandits have taken your mother and your beloved; you can only save one. Which? Think carefully before you answer.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.granny: Good. There is no right answer: silence was the only one. The road to Zaban is behind the house.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.sushi: Sushi? This? Fail. Everyone fails, nobody passes!
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.netero_split: Come now, Menchi… I propose a test the examiner will take herself: Mount Split. The airship will take us there.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.egg: A spider eagle egg! Well… this one, I find perfect. You pass.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.storm: Stay on deck through the storm (crouch against the gusts)
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.granny: Answer the Quiz Granny of Dolle
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.numele: Follow Satotz through the fog of the Numele wetlands
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.sushi: Bring a sushi (a salmon) to Menchi
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.egg: Jump into the Mount Split crevice and bring a spider eagle egg to Menchi
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.zevil: Gather 6 badge points on Zevil Island
quest.hxh.quiz.wrong: Wrong answer. Talk to them again to retry.
exam.hxh.storm: The storm breaks! Crouch to weather the gusts.
exam.hxh.overboard: Man overboard! The crew fishes you out.
exam.hxh.river: You missed the threads and ended up in the river. Back to the edge of the crevice.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.guide: You want to become a Hunter? The exam site must be earned. Here is your applicant badge. An Association airship is waiting for you at the coordinates I give you.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.guide: Find a guide for the Hunter Exam
exam.hxh.trial_special: Special trial (not counted): %s. Rest, eat, then talk to the Chairman when you are ready.
exam.hxh.big_wave: A huge wave is coming! Take shelter at the glowing spot!
exam.hxh.big_wave_timer: Wave in %s s — reach the shelter!
exam.hxh.big_wave_safe: The wave crashes on the deck… you held on.
exam.hxh.big_wave_hit: The wave sweeps you across the deck!
exam.hxh.zaban_lift_hint: Sit on the platform with the two seats: the room is about to go down.
exam.hxh.overboard_fail: Overboard! The captain doesn't keep applicants who can't stay on their feet.
quest.hxh.quiz.wrong_exam: Wrong answer: you are out of this session.
command.hxh.exam_plan_unknown: Unknown trial: %s (dolle, zaban, numele, biska, menchi, zevil)
dialog.hxh.passeur.idle: This airship is waiting for a Hunter Exam applicant.
dialog.hxh.passeur.not_yours: This airship isn't waiting for this applicant. Check the coordinates you were given.
exam.hxh.departure: Your airship is waiting: x %s, z %s (%s blocks away). Climb aboard and talk to the hostess.
exam.hxh.departure_objective: Reach your airship (x %s, z %s) and talk to the hostess
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.tournament: Final trial: a tournament. You win by making your opponent say "I give up"; only one applicant will fail.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.duels: Win the final tournament (make your opponents give up)
exam.hxh.duel_second_chance: You give up… but you get another chance: another applicant awaits. No more mistakes.
exam.hxh.duel_out: You give up a second time: you are the one applicant who fails this year.
command.hxh.exam_go_none: No pending departure point (talk to a guide first).
dialog.hxh.passeur.offer: Welcome aboard, applicant. This airship will take you to your next trial: %s. Ready?
dialog.hxh.passeur.gone: This trial is no longer available: you have already completed or attempted it.
dialog.hxh.passeur.too_far: You must be aboard your airship to board.
exam.hxh.guide_objective: Find a guide (waiting near x %s, z %s)
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.ball_intro: Ho ho! It's a long flight. A little game? Take this ball from me and you win. You have one minute.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.ball_intro: Join Chairman Netero aboard the airship
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.ball: Take Netero's ball (touch him despite his dodges)
exam.hxh.ball_time: Ho ho ho, the ball stays mine. It was only a game: the exam goes on.
exam.hxh.ball_won: Ho ho! You made me use my right hand and my leg. Keep the ball as a souvenir, and here are %s jenny for your trouble.
dialog.hxh.tonpa.idle: Heh heh, a newcomer! You can count on me, I'm here to help rookies…
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_intro: Welcome to the top of Trick Tower. Third phase: get to the bottom, alive, in under 5 minutes. The clock starts now. Finding the way is up to you.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_intro: Listen to Lippo, the prison warden
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_roof: Find the trapdoor leading inside the tower
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_vote: Vote with the other applicants (the path of the majority)
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_fight: Get past the prisoner blocking your way
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_exit: Get down to the exit before time runs out (beware the staircase traps)
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.tower_vote: Heh heh… the majority has spoken.
exam.hxh.tower_vote: Vote: %s for O, %s for X. Chosen door: %s.
exam.hxh.tower_vote_won: The majority followed you: the short path.
exam.hxh.tower_vote_lost: The majority voted against you (Tonpa, no doubt): door X leads to the long path, all around the tower.
exam.hxh.tower_time: Time is up: you remain a prisoner of the tower.
exam.hxh.leroute_intro: I don't fight. We bet time: %2$s coin tosses, each one you lose costs you %3$s seconds. Bet #%1$s: heads or tails?
exam.hxh.leroute_won: %s… Well played. Time lost so far: %s s.
exam.hxh.leroute_lost: %s! You lose. Time lost so far: %s s.
exam.hxh.leroute_done: Betting is over. Go ahead, and good luck with the time you have left.
dialog.hxh.kiriko_wife.idle: Help us… one of these two men is not my husband.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.kiriko_intro: A beast attacked us… it took my husband's shape. Now there are two of them, there, in front of the cabin. Talk to them, look closely, then come back and tell me which one is the beast.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.kiriko_intro: Listen to the wounded woman in the forest
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.kiriko_accuse: Examine both husbands (talk to them), then point out the Kiriko to the woman
exam.hxh.kiriko.real.0: (He clutches his bloody arm.) That beast clawed me as it carried my wife off… Don't let it get away!
exam.hxh.kiriko.real.1: (His shirt is torn, he limps.) I tried to hold it back, it threw me against a tree.
exam.hxh.kiriko.real.2: (Dirt and blood on his hands.) My wife… is she all right? Let me see her!
exam.hxh.kiriko.real.3: (He is shaking, a cut on his forehead.) I couldn't do anything, it was too fast…
exam.hxh.kiriko.fake.0: (Not a scratch, not a stain.) That beast clawed me, yes, yes… Hurry up, applicant.
exam.hxh.kiriko.fake.1: (His eyes glint for a moment in the shadows.) Don't waste time with the other one, he's the beast.
exam.hxh.kiriko.fake.2: (He doesn't even glance at his wife.) My wife? She'll recover. Deal with him instead.
exam.hxh.kiriko.fake.3: (Barely breathing, perfectly calm.) I fought like a lion. Look at me: not a single wound.
exam.hxh.kiriko.reveal: The false husband twists and grows: it's a Kiriko! "Well spotted, applicant. You deserve to reach Zaban."
exam.hxh.kiriko.wrong: You pointed at the real husband… The Kiriko bursts out laughing and vanishes into the trees. No guide for you.
dialog.hxh.hotel_manager.idle: A room with a view of the bay? Three gold coins, not one less.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.island_manager: Welcome, applicant! You'll spend the night here before the rest of the exam. The room costs three gold coins… No money? They say a wreck lies at the bottom of the bay, at the end of the pier.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.island_dive: Three coins! Here's your key… But what's that rumbling? A wave! And pirates firing cannons! Hold on!
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.island_done: You held on! The hotel is safe, thanks to you. The airship is waiting for the rest.
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.island_manager: Talk to the island hotel manager
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.island_dive: Dive to the wreck in the bay and bring 3 gold coins to the manager
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.island_wave: Withstand the giant wave and the cannonballs (crouch against the wave)
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.island_done: Go back to the hotel manager
exam.hxh.wave_swept: The wave swept you away! You get back onto the beach… start over.
dialog.hxh.hunter_exam.ko_intro: Welcome to the 288th Hunter Exam! First phase… um… They say an applicant last year knocked everyone out with a single move. Let's see what you're worth. Careful, here they come!
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.ko_intro: Listen to Beans on the opening esplanade
quest.hxh.hunter_exam.ko: Knock out every applicant before time runs out
exam.hxh.ko_start: %s applicants rush at you! Knock them all out in %s seconds.
exam.hxh.ko_time: Time is up: some applicants are still standing.
exam.hxh.ko_done: Nobody left standing. Just like Killua at the 288th Exam!
event.hxh.manieur_errant: A wandering Nen user was spotted near x %s, z %s. Bounty: %s Jenny.
event.hxh.horde_renforcee: A horde of Nen-reinforced undead is marching near x %s, z %s. Bounty: %s Jenny each.
event.hxh.transmuteurs: Two dangerous transmuters are causing trouble near x %s, z %s. Bounty: %s Jenny each.
event.hxh.archers_de_nuit: Skeleton archers firing aura arrows in the night near x %s, z %s. Bounty: %s Jenny each.
technique.hxh.netero_kannon_fists.desc: Kannon lends Netero its fists: for 10 s his blows are strengthened (×1.6), golden hands on his fists. Costs 15 Prayer.
message.hxh.prayer_start: You join your hands and pray… don't move.
technique.hxh.cond.rain: around the aimed point (%s blocks), over a %s-block radius
message.hxh.ging_nothing: Nothing to copy: no technique seen recently.
message.hxh.neon_calm: The poem speaks of no danger… for now.
message.hxh.neon_poem: "%s shadows prowl; the nearest comes from the %s."
passive.hxh.biscuit_two_forms.desc: Biscuit switches between two forms: the big one (2.5 blocks, very muscular) hits ×1.5 but wears her aura; the small one (1.5 blocks) hits ×0.8 but her aura recovers faster.
technique.hxh.biscuit_switch_form.desc: Switch from the small to the big form, or back.
passive.hxh.chrollo_head.desc: The head of the spider: +5% damage per Phantom Troupe member within 16 blocks (up to 40%).
technique.hxh.knov_mark_door.desc: Marks the door you look at (5 blocks). Marks: 1, plus 1 per 20 Nen levels (up to 6); the oldest fades.
passive.hxh.knuckle_hakoware.desc: Pot-Clean follows one target at a time: each of Knuckle's blows lends it half the damage (12 → +6), interest +5% every 10 s. Debt = target's max aura: bankruptcy, 20 s of forced Zetsu, no more protection against Nen.
technique.hxh.knuckle_pot_clean.desc: Pot-Clean attaches to the target in front of you (10 blocks); one at a time.
technique.hxh.knuckle_cancel.desc: Pot-Clean leaves, the debt is cleared.
technique.hxh.cond.steal: a target in front of you (%s blocks), or the stolen page
technique.hxh.cond.turns: one more arm turn, then strike
technique.hxh.cond.control: a mob in front of you (%s blocks), at most %s Nen levels above you
technique.hxh.cond.door: a door you look at (5 blocks)
message.hxh.chrollo_nothing: Nothing to steal: the target hasn't cast any technique.
message.hxh.shalnark_no_target: No mob to control in front of you.
message.hxh.shalnark_too_strong: The antenna doesn't take: Nen %s against your %s, gap too wide.
message.hxh.knov_refuge: You are in your refuge room. Cast Hide and Seek again or click to leave.
message.hxh.hako_bankrupt: Bankruptcy! %s has no aura left to protect itself.
message.hxh.hako_bankrupt_you: Bankruptcy: forced Zetsu, no more protection against Nen.
